gold.user: As a user, I want to retrieve details about a specific conference using its unique SID so that I can check its status and participants.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON object containing the conference details, including its status, participants, and any scheduled events.

gold.user: As a user, I want to update the settings of an existing conference by providing its SID and the new parameters so that I can modify its behavior.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with the updated conference parameters and return a confirmation of the update along with the updated conference details.

gold.user: As a user, I want to list all conferences associated with my account so that I can manage them effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON array of conference objects, each containing details such as SID, status, and participant count.
